clusters.pick_reason: PR #2243 is a bug fix that handles the gateway path-prefix problem automatically with no API change required — `urljoin` silently drops the proxy prefix today and users have no workaround. PR #2531's explicit `messages_url` override is a complementary feature (useful when automatic detection isn't enough) but does not fix the silent data-loss for users who are unaware of the bug. The gateway fix should land first; the manual-override parameter from #2531 can be layered on top in a follow-up without conflict. PR #2483 is independent — it wraps the POST call to propagate `httpx.HTTPError` instead of hanging, a separate error-handling issue.
